title: Applications open:- PvPI Internship Programme 2026
bodyHtml:
Applications open: PvPI Internship Programme 2026

The Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (PvPI) is initiating an internship programme designed to provide young professionals and students with an opportunity to develop skills and gain exposure in the field of Pharmacovigilance.

Mode: Physical Mode

Last Date of Registration: 31st October, 2026

Open for students who are pursuing or completed graduation/postgraduation in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Medical Sciences, Dental Sciences, Nursing, M.Sc In (Clinical Pharmacology/Clinical research) and Allied Health Sciences.

Apply now: https://forms.gle/QkD84fPVpJo1ZRYMA (opens in a new tab)
